title: 心理学データ解析応用
subtitle: Advanced Psychological Data Analysis
keywords: Data cleaning and handling 2.Statistical analysis 3.R(software) 4.Effect size, 95%CI, power 5.Power analysis
educationalGoal: The goals of this course are: 1) to provide students with the basic knowledge to use software for data analyses in psychological research, and 2) to apply this knowledge to actual data analysis. In addition, we aim to statistically analyze the data obtained from previous psychological research and make socially and academically meaningful claims and proposals. Acquire essential skills for research in Project Design III.
advice: Current psychological study requires researchers to use R software, which enables various statistical analyses from basic analyses (e.g., t-test, ANOVA) to multivariate analyses (e.g., regression analysis, factorial analysis). Students also deepen their understanding of sample size design and power analysis, as well as indicators such as effect sizes and confidence intervals in addition to p-values, and acquire the ability to calculate them. R is so useful that students make use of it in their Project Design III, but it is difficult to learn how to use it. Students should make use of office hours and peer instructions.
requiredKnowledge: Students should make use of their previous knowledge of data analysis during the course. Students are expected to review the knowledge on statistical analysis. Students must bring their own personal computer to every class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to run the statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
Be able to run multivariate analyses with using R.
Be able to analyze data with applying an appropriate method and draw its figures and tables.
Be able to interpret the results of analysis and make an effective presentation.
